summary: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, completed its $287.5 million IPO on September 18, 2026, selling 28,750,000 units at $10.00 each, including the full 3,750,000-unit over-allotment. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. Cantor Fitzgerald and William Blair served as representatives. Ancillary agreements include underwriting, warrant, investment management trust, and registration rights agreements. The SPAC structure implies a 21-month combination window with a trust-funded overhang; investors await a target announcement, extension votes, or redemption mechanics as the principal risk-arb catalyst.
